items.text: Chaired a group of legislators whose board wrote to the head of government urging that immigration enforcement continue in a city where it had met protests, using every tool including emergency powers to deploy troops, that local governments limiting cooperation with it lose national funding, and that the department in charge of immigration enforcement be fully funded.

Pressed party leaders for a floor vote on a bill writing the head of government's border measures into law, including finishing the border wall, ending the release of migrants awaiting hearings, and tightening asylum standards.
